==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I used the wake up, lay back down, and induce sleep paralysis method once again to attain lucidity. I flew around the Earth as colorful ribbons of neon light. Embracing speed in its purest form. My wandering thoughts reshaped the dream into a slideshow of information about AI, superheroes, and lucidity.
